OBJECTIVE_CHAIN: Keep the brain-structure goal and gain/coupling/delay distinction; test whether C18's conditional intervention inference survives the shunting term of a conductance intervention.
BIO_STARTING_MECHANISM: Linearization of I_add=G_add*s*(E_rev-V) contributes coupling and -G_add*s0*deltaV. Normalize baseline leak to 1; h is added tonic leak in those units. This is a conditional scalar model, not established whole-CNS biology.
CE_DELTA: No CE term or anatomical claim. One model change: retain the omitted shunt h.
MEASUREMENT_MODEL: R=(1+i*w*tm+g*k*exp(-i*w*tau))/(1+h+i*w*tm+g*(k+d)*exp(-i*w*tau)), d=0.1. Constant capacitance implies post-intervention effective membrane time tm/(1+h). Same exogenous input and recording filter are assumed across conditions.
DATA_PROVENANCE: Synthetic only; C18 originals retained and hash checked. The independently calibrated mapping from physical conductance to d and h is not available.
DATA_SPLIT: Fixed development grid; seed 20260907, two independent noise replicates per case. Not biological holdout.
OBSERVABLES: 48 complex ratios, 0.3 to 3 Hz; real and imaginary noise SD 0.01, independent. Same observation support as C18.
ESTIMANDS: Recovery of baseline g,k,tau when tm,h are ignored, jointly fitted, or independently measured exactly. Exact measurement is an ideal positive control, not a feasible error budget.
RESIDUAL_RULE: Log-parameter finite-difference step 1e-5, linear h step 1e-5; relative singular-value rank threshold 1e-7. Noiseless joint-fit success requires maximum g/k/tau/tm relative error <=0.001 and absolute h error <=0.001. Report all noise errors and failures. No sample-size/P3/P6 claim.
FALSIFIER: Rank or recovery failure limits joint nuisance fitting; lower noise performance under exact calibration identifies a measurement requirement, not permission to assume calibration. Any unrestricted recording-filter equivalence defeats unconstrained identification.
MATCHED_CONTROLS: C18 h=0 reduction; omitted-shunt C18 fit; joint tm/h fit; oracle-calibrated tm/h; exact alternative-mechanism plus recording-filter witness.
MODEL_SELECTION: g=[0.8,1.2], k=[0.25,0.4], tau=[0.08,0.3,0.6], tm=0.02, h=[0,0.1,0.3], total 36. No parameter/grid changes after output. All generated and accepted fitted loops must satisfy g*k<1 and g*(k+d)<1+h.
REVISION_TRIGGER: Retain any failed rows. Do not revise C18 or the old spec. New biological or more complex model work requires a separate contract and independent measurements.
